visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Exceptions Instead of Checking First
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The function tests for zero before dividing and repeats the final message on both paths. Use try / except / else / finally so the message is written once. The output must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
def divide(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        print("cannot divide by zero")
        print("done")
        return None
    print("ok")
    print("done")
    return a / b


print(divide(10, 4))
print(divide(1, 0))

solution.explanation: finally guarantees the closing message on every path, including future ones, so it no longer has to be copied before each return.
